profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, traded on public markets under the ticker META. Its llama.com site presents the company as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. The site highlights several products: Muse Spark, a coding-optimized model described as competitive with leading alternatives for coding agents and review bots; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; Muse Image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing and is priced at $0.01 per image via the Meta Model API; and Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and designed to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also references search grounding, which gives models live web access via a single tool call, and multi-agent workflow support. Meta's tracked AI product is the Llama family, described as an open-weight model series that is often self-hosted.

The held facts show Meta reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, filed on a 10-K form with the SEC under CIK 0001326801. On the litigation side, Meta faces three tracked cases: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California. Several third-party MCP servers have been registered that connect to Meta's advertising infrastructure, including tools for campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
